_belge: Project 45 ve 45a. Aile ön ekleri her prompt'un başına eklenir. Sayılar oyunda da kullanılır (soundbank'e kopyalanır).

api._not: Pro ayında biçimleri pcm_44100 ya da mp3_44100_192 yap (daha yüksek kalite). Biçim reddedilirse işçi mp3_44100_128'e düşer.

A._: çok sık: ayak, arayüz, balta, çapa

ui.prefix: Soft organic user-interface sound for a cozy medieval game, textures of wood, linen cloth and thread (embroidery theme), very short and gentle. No digital beeps, no synth, no music, no voice.

foley.prefix: Medieval village foley, dry close-mic recording, no reverb, no music, no voice.

tools.prefix: Medieval hand tool sound, dry close-mic recording, no reverb, no music, no voice.

craft.prefix: Medieval craft workshop sound, dry recording, no music, no voice.

animals.prefix: Real farm animal sound recorded outdoors at close distance, natural, no music, no human voice.

ambience.prefix: Medieval countryside ambience bed, continuous and even, no music, no voices, no modern sounds (no cars, no engines, no planes).

spots.prefix: Single isolated nature sound event, natural outdoor recording, nothing else audible, no music, no voice.

weather.prefix: Weather ambience, continuous, no music, no voices, no modern sounds.

music.prefix: Instrumental medieval folk music for a cozy village life game. Period instruments only: lute, recorder, kaval flute, hurdy-gurdy, frame drum, bagpipe, lyre, harp. No piano, no synthesizer, no electric guitar, no modern drum kit, no vocals.

stinger.prefix: Very short medieval folk music sting, period instruments only (lute, recorder, frame drum, bells). No piano, no synth, no vocals.
